<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow character</title>
<style>
html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #fffefd; }
canvas { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; display: block; width: 244px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 244;
const height = 240;
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffefd);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122, 122, 120, -120, 1, 1100);
ref.position.set(0, 0, 500);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
ref.layers.enable(1);

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(width, height),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    depthWrite: false,
    vertexShader: `
      void main() { gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      void main() {
        vec2 p = vec2(gl_FragCoord.x, 240.0 - gl_FragCoord.y);
        float fade = smoothstep(199.0, 242.0, p.y);
        float edge = smoothstep(32.0, 122.0, abs(p.x - 122.0));
        float grain = fract(sin(dot(floor(p), vec2(37.17, 71.53))) * 4183.17) - .5;
        vec3 white = vec3(1.0, .996, .988);
        vec3 floorColor = vec3(.78, .765, .76) - edge * vec3(.091, .072, .046);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(white, floorColor, fade * .93) + grain * .024 * fade, 1.0);
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'white-background-and-floor';
backdrop.position.z = -225;
backdrop.layers.set(1);
backdrop.renderOrder = -1;
scene.add(backdrop);

const world = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x - 122, 120 - y, z);
const clamp = (v, lo = 0, hi = 1) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
const smooth = (a, b, x) => {
  const u = clamp((x - a) / (b - a));
  return u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
};
const gaussian = (x, y, sx, sy) => Math.exp(-((x / sx) ** 2 + (y / sy) ** 2));
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const palette = rows => rows.map(([at, hex]) => [at, color(hex)]);

function shadeAt(stops, value) {
  for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) {
    if (value <= stops[i][0]) {
      const [a, ca] = stops[i - 1];
      const [b, cb] = stops[i];
      return ca.clone().lerp(cb, smooth(a, b, value));
    }
  }
  return stops[stops.length - 1][1].clone();
}

function group(parent, name, position = new THREE.Vector3()) {
  const node = new THREE.Group();
  node.name = name;
  node.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(node);
  return node;
}

const character = group(scene, 'character-yellow');
const torso = group(character, 'torso');
const headRest = world(124, 69, 0);
const head = group(character, 'head', headRest);
const eyes = group(head, 'eyes');
const mouth = group(head, 'mouth', world(123, 47, 36).sub(headRest));

function surfaceMaterial(grain, transparent = false) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    vertexColors: true,
    transparent,
    depthWrite: !transparent,
    uniforms: { grainAmount: { value: grain } },
    vertexShader: `
      attribute float opacity;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vPoint;
      varying vec3 vTint;
      varying float vOpacity;
      void main() {
        vec3 vn = normalMatrix * normal;
        vNormal = vec3(dot(viewMatrix[0].xyz, vn), dot(viewMatrix[1].xyz, vn),
                       dot(viewMatrix[2].xyz, vn));
        vPoint = position;
        vTint = color;
        vOpacity = opacity;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform float grainAmount;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vPoint;
      varying vec3 vTint;
      varying float vOpacity;
      float hash(vec3 p) {
        p = fract(p * vec3(.1031, .1030, .0973));
        p += dot(p, p.yxz + 33.33);
        return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
      }
      void main() {
        vec3 n = normalize(vNormal);
        float key = dot(n, normalize(vec3(-.30, .68, .88))) * .5 + .5;
        float fill = dot(n, normalize(vec3(.71, .42, -.81))) * .5 + .5;
        float lower = dot(n, normalize(vec3(.18, -.93, .32))) * .5 + .5;
        float light = .60 + .38 * key + .12 * fill + .047 * lower;
        float noise = hash(floor(vPoint * vec3(1.5, 1.5, 1.7))) - .5;
        vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
        float dither = hash(vec3(pixel, 17.0)) - .5;
        float checker = mod(pixel.x + pixel.y, 2.0) - .5;
        vec3 rgb = vTint * (light + grainAmount * (noise + .21 * checker))
                 * vec3(1.02, 1.0, .974);
        rgb += dither * grainAmount * .043;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(max(rgb, vec3(0.0)), vOpacity);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  });
}

const skin = surfaceMaterial(.083);
const handsMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.108);
const eyeMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.02);
const mouthMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.045, true);

function addMesh(parent, name, material, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices) {
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('opacity', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(opacity, 1));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

// Screen height, left and right silhouette, depth center, depth radius.
const bodyProfile = [
  [-6, 124, 124, -1, .02],
  [-3, 108, 142, -1, 14],
  [2, 99, 149, -1, 23],
  [11, 93, 155, -1, 30],
  [23, 88, 159, -1, 36],
  [36, 85, 164, -2, 40],
  [51, 79, 173, -3, 43],
  [65, 70, 185, -4, 46],
  [81, 62, 195, -5, 49],
  [103, 56, 200, -6, 54],
  [128, 49, 204, -7, 59],
  [151, 44, 210, -8, 63],
  [173, 39, 214, -9, 66],
  [194, 35, 217, -10, 68],
  [212, 35, 215, -10, 66],
  [228, 39, 211, -10, 61],
  [242, 45, 205, -10, 54],
  [254, 56, 195, -10, 45],
  [265, 78, 174, -10, 32],
  [271, 103, 149, -10, 17],
  [273, 126, 126, -10, .02]
];

function hermite(a, b, m0, m1, t) {
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * a + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * m0 +
         (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b + (t3 - t2) * m1;
}

function section(profile, y) {
  const last = profile.length - 1;
  if (y <= profile[0][0]) return profile[0].slice(1);
  if (y >= profile[last][0]) return profile[last].slice(1);
  let i = 0;
  while (y > profile[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = profile[i];
  const b = profile[i + 1];
  const before = profile[Math.max(i - 1, 0)];
  const after = profile[Math.min(i + 2, last)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = (y - a[0]) / span;
  const result = [];
  for (let k = 1; k < a.length; k++) {
    const m0 = span * (b[k] - before[k]) / (b[0] - before[0]);
    const m1 = span * (after[k] - a[k]) / (after[0] - a[0]);
    result.push(hermite(a[k], b[k], m0, m1, t));
  }
  return result;
}

function crossSection(profile, y, angle, sculpt) {
  const [left, right, center, depth] = section(profile, y);
  const front = Math.cos(angle);
  const x = (left + right) * .5 + Math.max(.015, (right - left) * .5) * Math.sin(angle);
  const z = center + Math.max(.015, depth) * front + sculpt(x, y, front);
  return world(x, y, z);
}

function makeShell(parent, name, profile, first, last, material, tint, sculpt = () => 0) {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], opacity = [], indices = [];
  const slices = 96;
  const rows = Math.ceil((last - first) / 1.1);
  const origin = parent.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const point = (y, a) => crossSection(profile, y, a, sculpt);

  for (let row = 0; row <= rows; row++) {
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(first, last, row / rows);
    for (let j = 0; j <= slices; j++) {
      const angle = 2 * Math.PI * j / slices;
      const p = point(y, angle);
      const dy = point(y + .06, angle).sub(point(y - .06, angle));
      const da = point(y, angle + .003).sub(point(y, angle - .003));
      const normal = dy.cross(da).normalize();
      const c = tint(p.x + 122, y, Math.cos(angle));
      positions.push(p.x - origin.x, p.y - origin.y, p.z - origin.z);
      normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      opacity.push(1);
      if (row < rows && j < slices) {
        const a = row * (slices + 1) + j;
        const b = a + slices + 1;
        indices.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  if (first === profile[0][0]) {
    for (let j = 1; j < slices - 1; j++) indices.push(0, j, j + 1);
  }
  if (last === profile[profile.length - 1][0]) {
    const base = rows * (slices + 1);
    for (let j = 1; j < slices - 1; j++) indices.push(base, base + j + 1, base + j);
  }

  return addMesh(parent, name, material, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices);
}

const coat = palette([
  [-6, 0xffeda5], [13, 0xf7e480], [32, 0xf4d45d], [52, 0xf3cb51],
  [75, 0xffd972], [111, 0xecbd59], [152, 0xe6b66c], [189, 0xd6ab62],
  [220, 0xc9a052], [248, 0xbc9045], [273, 0xb58b42]
]);
const breast = palette([
  [69, 0xffdb83], [99, 0xffe0a2], [130, 0xffe3b2], [160, 0xffdeb0],
  [185, 0xfad3a0], [209, 0xe9bd7b], [236, 0xd2a65b], [263, 0xc39a4d]
]);
const contact = color(0x9e6c22);
const lidWarmth = color(0xa28932);
const muzzleLight = color(0xffe68b);

function bodySculpt(x, y, front) {
  const f = Math.max(0, front);
  return f * f * (3.8 * gaussian(x - 123, y - 44, 20, 15) +
    2.7 * gaussian(x - 130, y - 151, 50, 58));
}

function bodyTint(x, y, front) {
  const c = shadeAt(coat, y);
  const facing = smooth(.18, .81, front);
  const bellyWidth = 50 + 19 * smooth(75, 163, y);
  const bellySize = Math.hypot((x - 128) / bellyWidth, (y - 151) / 77);
  const belly = (1 - smooth(.49, 1.16, bellySize)) * facing;
  c.lerp(shadeAt(breast, y), belly * .96);
  const underArms = .24 * gaussian(x - 63, y - 142, 16, 27) +
    .27 * gaussian(x - 193, y - 116, 19, 32);
  c.lerp(contact, underArms * smooth(-.14, .53, front));
  const eyelids = .48 * gaussian(x - 102, y - 25.5, 8.4, 9.0) +
    .53 * gaussian(x - 145, y - 20.5, 8.3, 8.3);
  c.lerp(lidWarmth, eyelids * facing);
  c.lerp(muzzleLight, .62 * facing * gaussian(x - 121, y - 34.8, 18, 5.2));
  return c;
}

const bodyMesh = makeShell(torso, 'pear-shaped-body', bodyProfile, 69, 273, skin, bodyTint, bodySculpt);
makeShell(head, 'rounded-head', bodyProfile, -6, 69, skin, bodyTint, bodySculpt);

function faceZ(x, y) {
  const [left, right] = section(bodyProfile, y);
  const sine = clamp((2 * x - left - right) / (right - left), -.999, .999);
  return crossSection(bodyProfile, y, Math.asin(sine), bodySculpt).z;
}

function faceNormal(x, y) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(
    faceZ(x - .1, y) - faceZ(x + .1, y),
    faceZ(x, y + .1) - faceZ(x, y - .1),
    .2
  ).normalize();
}

function makeMouth() {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], opacity = [], indices = [];
  const origin = mouth.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const inner = color(0xdc9637);
  const edge = color(0xe8a840);
  const lower = color(0xd98d32);
  const rim = color(0xffd36c);
  const rings = 26, steps = 84;
  for (let i = 0; i <= rings; i++) {
    const r = Math.max(.001, i / rings);
    for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
      const a = 2 * Math.PI * j / steps;
      const q = Math.cos(a) * r;
      const x = 122.6 + 23.2 * q;
      const y = 49.0 + Math.sin(a) * r * (Math.sin(a) < 0 ? 10.8 : 14.4) - 2.75 * q * q - 1.1 * q;
      const n = faceNormal(x, y);
      const p = world(x, y, faceZ(x, y) + .27 + .86 * (1 - r * r)).sub(origin);
      const c = inner.clone().lerp(edge, r * .72);
      c.lerp(lower, .53 * gaussian(x - 121, y - 47, 17, 6.7));
      c.lerp(rim, .49 * gaussian(x - 120, y - 56, 16, 7));
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      normals.push(n.x, n.y, n.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      opacity.push(.84 * (1 - smooth(.48, 1, r)));
      if (i < rings && j < steps) {
        const k = i * (steps + 1) + j;
        const next = k + steps + 1;
        indices.push(k, k + 1, next, k + 1, next + 1, next);
      }
    }
  }
  addMesh(mouth, 'soft-orange-mouth', mouthMaterial, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices);
}
makeMouth();

function ellipsoid(parent, name, radius, material, tint) {
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 42, 30);
  const positions = geo.attributes.position;
  const rgb = [], alpha = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
    const c = tint(positions.getX(i), positions.getY(i), positions.getZ(i));
    rgb.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    alpha.push(1);
  }
  geo.scale(...radius);
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('opacity', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(alpha, 1));
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const blackOlive = color(0x22240f);
const eyeEdge = color(0x4a481c);
const eyeGlint = color(0x877747);

function makeEye(name, x, y, rx, ry) {
  const n = faceNormal(x, y);
  const position = world(x, y, faceZ(x, y)).addScaledVector(n, -.46).sub(headRest);
  const eye = group(eyes, name, position);
  eye.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), n);
  ellipsoid(eye, 'dark-eye', [rx, ry, 2.65], eyeMaterial, (u, v, w) => {
    const c = blackOlive.clone().lerp(eyeEdge, .54 * (1 - smooth(.06, .85, w)));
    c.lerp(eyeGlint, .30 * gaussian(u + .24, v - .44, .28, .22) * Math.max(0, w));
    return c;
  });
}
makeEye('eye-on-image-left', 102.5, 25.5, 4.95, 5.65);
makeEye('eye-on-image-right', 145.1, 20.7, 5.2, 5.8);

const leftArmProfile = [
  [83, 70, 70, 37, .02], [90, 61, 79, 42, 9], [101, 50, 84, 42, 15],
  [113, 42, 88, 39, 20], [127, 37, 85, 35, 23], [139, 39, 80, 33, 21],
  [150, 45, 75, 30, 16], [157, 52, 67, 28, 9], [160, 60, 60, 27, .02]
];
const rightArmProfile = [
  [75, 209, 209, 44, .02], [83, 200, 219, 45, 11], [96, 194, 222, 43, 15],
  [109, 192, 228, 39, 20], [123, 194, 232, 33, 22], [135, 198, 229, 31, 19],
  [144, 204, 222, 28, 12], [150, 213, 213, 25, .02]
];
const leftHandProfile = [
  [72.5, 69, 69, 51, .02], [75, 63, 75, 52, 6], [80, 57, 80, 53, 10],
  [87, 53.5, 84, 53, 13], [94, 55, 87, 51, 13], [101, 61, 88, 49, 11],
  [108, 70, 87, 46, 8], [112, 80, 80, 43, .02]
];
const rightHandProfile = [
  [60.5, 212, 212, 52, .02], [64, 208, 217, 53, 5], [69, 205, 222, 54, 9],
  [76, 201, 225.5, 54, 11], [83, 198, 225, 52, 12], [90, 196.5, 220, 49, 11],
  [97, 198, 214, 46, 7], [102, 204, 204, 44, .02]
];

const armCoat = palette([
  [75, 0xe7b049], [96, 0xf9cc60], [110, 0xf9c755], [124, 0xf0ad3d],
  [137, 0xe5a039], [151, 0xca862a], [161, 0xbb7829]
]);
const armGoldenLight = color(0xffd981);
const armShadow = color(0xbd7928);
const pawCoat = palette([
  [60, 0x7e6e4b], [73, 0x696044], [84, 0x594b2e], [96, 0x514022],
  [107, 0x67512d], [113, 0x93703a]
]);
const pawRim = color(0x91784c);
const pawFold = color(0x3b3322);
const wrist = color(0xc08e40);

function armTint(left, x, y, front) {
  const base = shadeAt(armCoat, y + (left ? 0 : 3));
  base.lerp(armGoldenLight, .37 * gaussian(x - (left ? 53 : 218), y - 111, 18, 19) * smooth(.02, .89, front));
  base.lerp(armShadow, .37 * gaussian(x - (left ? 79 : 198), y - 128, 12, 21));
  return base;
}

function pawTint(left, x, y, front) {
  const c = shadeAt(pawCoat, y + (left ? -2 : 5));
  const sheen = left ? gaussian(x - 63, y - 81, 7.5, 9) : gaussian(x - 210, y - 72, 7, 8);
  c.lerp(pawRim, .51 * sheen);
  const crossing = left ? x - (67 + .45 * (y - 87)) : y - (88 - .33 * (x - 206));
  const fold = left ? gaussian(crossing, y - 91, 2.5, 11) : gaussian(crossing, x - 208, 1.65, 10);
  c.lerp(pawFold, .36 * fold * smooth(.15, .9, front));
  const lowerEdge = left ? 105.1 + .28 * (x - 77) : 96 - .28 * (x - 205);
  c.lerp(wrist, .83 * smooth(lowerEdge - 1, lowerEdge + 6, y));
  return c;
}

function deformable(mesh) {
  const geometry = mesh.geometry;
  const position = geometry.attributes.position;
  const normal = geometry.attributes.normal;
  position.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  normal.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  return {
    geometry, position, normal,
    restPosition: position.array.slice(),
    restNormal: normal.array.slice()
  };
}

function updateGeometry(part) {
  part.position.needsUpdate = true;
  part.normal.needsUpdate = true;
  part.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
  part.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
}

const bendingBody = deformable(bodyMesh);
const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

function makeArm(side, armProfile, handProfile, cuff, elbow, shoulder) {
  const left = side === 'left';
  const joint = group(torso, 'arm-on-image-' + side, world(...cuff));
  const hand = group(joint, 'hand-on-image-' + side);
  const lower = makeShell(joint, 'rounded-yellow-forearm', armProfile, armProfile[0][0],
    armProfile[armProfile.length - 1][0], skin, (x, y, f) => armTint(left, x, y, f));
  makeShell(hand, 'dark-mitten-shaped-hand', handProfile, handProfile[0][0],
    handProfile[handProfile.length - 1][0], handsMaterial, (x, y, f) => pawTint(left, x, y, f));
  const upper = ellipsoid(joint, 'upper-arm', [left ? 14 : 16, 1, 14], skin,
    (u, v, w) => shadeAt(armCoat, 114 - 14 * v).lerp(armGoldenLight, .12 * Math.max(0, w)));

  return { joint, upper, hand, cuff, elbow, shoulder, lower: deformable(lower) };
}

const leftArm = makeArm('left', leftArmProfile, leftHandProfile,
  [73, 103, 48], [61, 127, 35], [70, 103, 16]);
const rightArm = makeArm('right', rightArmProfile, rightHandProfile,
  [206, 95, 45], [213, 123, 33], [181, 104, 15]);

const period = 1200;
const times = [0, 160, 340, 500, 680, 840, 1020, 1180];

// The head track gives the eye midpoint in the image and the change in roll.
const headKeys = [
  [123.8, 23.1, 0],
  [125.1, 24.0, -11.0],
  [125.0, 28.0, -1.1],
  [124.0, 34.0, -9.2],
  [125.0, 29.4, -8.1],
  [123.9, 25.6, .4],
  [124.4, 28.8, -10.2],
  [125.5, 32.7, -.9]
];

// Cuff x/y, elbow x/y, depth offset, arm width, mitten roll, mitten width and height.
const leftKeys = [
  [73, 103, 61, 127, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
  [22, 88, 27, 109, -7, .88, 6, .78, 1.09],
  [65, 117, 55, 143, -1, .95, 13, 1.04, 1.01],
  [32, 126, 32, 145, -5, .89, 13, 1.00, 1.15],
  [26, 119, 37, 139, -6, .87, 7, .86, 1.08],
  [66, 108, 56, 133, 0, 1.00, 6, 1.09, 1.02],
  [24, 108, 31, 130, -7, .88, 7, .88, 1.13],
  [49, 131, 50, 153, -2, .98, 10, 1.06, 1.06]
];
const rightKeys = [
  [206, 95, 213, 123, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
  [148, 112, 174, 138, 22, 1.19, -1, 1.30, 1.00],
  [205, 107, 213, 134, 0, 1.00, -1, 1.01, .99],
  [179, 136, 197, 160, 16, 1.15, -12, 1.29, .97],
  [168, 123, 191, 149, 20, 1.16, -5, 1.31, .98],
  [205, 107, 211, 133, 0, 1.00, 1, 1.00, .98],
  [163, 126, 184, 151, 21, 1.14, -8, 1.28, .98],
  [200, 126, 211, 149, 4, 1.01, -8, 1.12, 1.05]
];

function interval(i) {
  return i === times.length - 1 ? period - times[i] : times[i + 1] - times[i];
}

function trackSlopes(keys) {
  const count = keys.length;
  return keys.map((values, i) => {
    const previous = (i - 1 + count) % count;
    const next = (i + 1) % count;
    const h0 = interval(previous), h1 = interval(i);
    return values.map((value, k) => {
      const before = (value - keys[previous][k]) / h0;
      const after = (keys[next][k] - value) / h1;
      if (before * after <= 0) return 0;
      const w0 = 2 * h1 + h0, w1 = h1 + 2 * h0;
      return (w0 + w1) / (w0 / before + w1 / after);
    });
  });
}

const headSlopes = trackSlopes(headKeys);
const leftSlopes = trackSlopes(leftKeys);
const rightSlopes = trackSlopes(rightKeys);

function sample(keys, slopes, i, h, u) {
  const j = (i + 1) % keys.length;
  return keys[i].map((value, k) => hermite(value, keys[j][k], h * slopes[i][k], h * slopes[j][k], u));
}

function poseHead([eyeX, eyeY, roll]) {
  const angle = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(roll);
  const cos = Math.cos(angle), sin = Math.sin(angle);
  const eyeOffsetX = 123.8 - 124;
  const eyeOffsetY = 69 - 23.1;
  head.rotation.z = angle;
  head.position.set(
    eyeX - 122 - (cos * eyeOffsetX - sin * eyeOffsetY),
    120 - eyeY - (sin * eyeOffsetX + cos * eyeOffsetY),
    0
  );

  const part = bendingBody;
  const xChange = head.position.x - headRest.x;
  const yChange = head.position.y - headRest.y;
  const p = part.restPosition, n = part.restNormal;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) {
    const y = p[i + 1];
    const u = clamp((y - (headRest.y - 97)) / 97);
    const w = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
    const dw = 6 * u * (1 - u) / 97;
    const dx = p[i] - headRest.x;
    const dy = y - headRest.y;
    const bendX = (cos - 1) * dx - sin * dy + xChange;
    const bendY = sin * dx + (cos - 1) * dy + yChange;

    part.position.setXYZ(i / 3, p[i] + w * bendX, y + w * bendY, p[i + 2]);
    const a = 1 + w * (cos - 1);
    const b = -w * sin + dw * bendX;
    const c = w * sin;
    const d = a + dw * bendY;
    const det = a * d - b * c;
    const nx = (d * n[i] - c * n[i + 1]) / det;
    const ny = (a * n[i + 1] - b * n[i]) / det;
    const nz = n[i + 2];
    const length = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1;
    part.normal.setXYZ(i / 3, nx / length, ny / length, nz / length);
  }
  updateGeometry(part);
}

const upperStart = new THREE.Vector3();
const upperEnd = new THREE.Vector3();
const upperDirection = new THREE.Vector3();
const bendRange = Math.tanh(1 / .95);

function poseArm(arm, [x, y, elbowX, elbowY, depth, widthScale, roll, handWidth, handHeight]) {
  const { joint, upper, hand, cuff, elbow, shoulder, lower: part } = arm;
  joint.position.set(x - 122, 120 - y, cuff[2] + depth);
  hand.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(roll);
  hand.scale.set(handWidth, handHeight, 1);

  const elbowDistance = elbow[1] - cuff[1];
  const heightScale = (elbowY - y) / elbowDistance;
  const bend = elbowX - x - widthScale * (elbow[0] - cuff[0]);
  const p = part.restPosition, n = part.restNormal;

  for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) {
    const localY = p[i + 1];
    const curve = Math.tanh(-localY / (.95 * elbowDistance));
    const shift = bend * curve / bendRange;
    const shear = -bend * (1 - curve * curve) / (.95 * elbowDistance * bendRange);
    part.position.setXYZ(i / 3, widthScale * p[i] + shift, heightScale * localY, p[i + 2]);

    const nx = n[i] / widthScale;
    const ny = (n[i + 1] - shear * nx) / heightScale;
    const nz = n[i + 2];
    const length = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1;
    part.normal.setXYZ(i / 3, nx / length, ny / length, nz / length);
  }
  updateGeometry(part);

  upperStart.set(shoulder[0] - 122, 120 - shoulder[1], shoulder[2]).sub(joint.position);
  upperEnd.set(elbowX - x, y - elbowY + 4, elbow[2] - cuff[2] - 5);
  upperDirection.subVectors(upperStart, upperEnd);
  const length = upperDirection.length();
  upper.position.copy(upperStart).add(upperEnd).multiplyScalar(.5);
  upper.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up, upperDirection.divideScalar(length));
  upper.scale.y = length * .5 + 10;
}

function render(t) {
  const phase = ((t % period) + period) % period;
  let i = times.length - 1;
  while (phase < times[i]) i--;
  const h = interval(i);
  const u = (phase - times[i]) / h;
  poseHead(sample(headKeys, headSlopes, i, h, u));
  poseArm(leftArm, sample(leftKeys, leftSlopes, i, h, u));
  poseArm(rightArm, sample(rightKeys, rightSlopes, i, h, u));
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [character], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
